Australians will soon be heading to Glasgow for this year's Commonwealth Games. (AAP: Darren England)

More than 250 Aussie athletes are competing at the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow. Do you know one of them?

ABC News would like help telling the stories of our athletes through the eyes of their closest and biggest fans.

Whether you are a family member, a friend, a colleague or a coach, share your connection with us and how you will be supporting them.
